options.label: D

explanationMd: Compute the rates separately: Garden: 48/80=60%; Building: 90/120=75%; Cleaning: 130/200=65%. Compare these proportions rather than raw successful counts. The highest rate is 75%.

distractorRationale.b: Compare each numerator with its own denominator. The rates are 60%, 75%, 65%; this claim does not identify all and only the highest-rate categories.
